1.consolidated_definition: alim. Crema. Crema de leche batida. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Yo probé la de vainilla con fresa y vainilla con vainilla. Puedo decir que son bien buenas sobretodo la de fresa por lo dulce que sabe. Lo unico que el whip cream que usan le cambia el sabor un poco (al menos a mí no me gustó) (El Drive Thru, 10-06-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Whip cream: A type of cream made from whipped milk. Anglicism used in its raw form, commonly employed. I tried the vanilla with strawberry and vanilla with vanilla flavors. I can say that they are quite good, especially the strawberry one due to its sweetness. The only thing is that the whip cream used alters the flavor slightly (at least it did not appeal to me).
